title: Nation Wants to Guess with Khamba | Finale ft. @kaneezsurka007 @sonofabish @rohanjoshi8016
summary: In the finale of The Nation Wants to Guess, host Gursimran Khamba guides Abish Mathew, Kaniz Surka, and Rohan Joshi through a rapid succession of buzz rounds on Japanese pornography, Naxalite surrenders, Taliban penal codes, and Prabhas monikers. The panel trades roasts on everything from DEMENT innerwear to Barbeque Nation while fumbling blindfolded 'Who Am I?' guesses and a final elimination round on Adolf Hitler. Rohan Joshi ultimately outlasts the others with 990 points and a satirical vintage AIB merch prize, closing the episode with a season two trailer.

scenes.title: Pre-show: 2.5 BHK and Caller
scenes.summary: Host interacts with an audience caller about a noisy green plot, emotional emails, and a 2.5 BHK real estate deal before officially launching the show.

scenes.title: Panel Introductions and Warm-up
scenes.summary: Host introduces Abish, Kaniz, and Rohan with self-deprecating roasts, banters about ages and competition, and establishes the show's unserious tone.

scenes.title: Round 1: True Story
scenes.summary: Host launches the first True Story question about a Japanese porn industry shortage, offers absurd multiple-choice options, and Kaniz guesses B MILFs while Rohan mocks the acronym.

scenes.title: Fluffer banter and Dements
scenes.summary: True Story round where the host explains the role of a fluffer and guests guess why the Japanese porn industry is running short.

scenes.title: Man count and sponsor wordplay
scenes.summary: Correct answer men is revealed; host cites absurd industry ratios and DEMENT meaning is clarified.

scenes.title: Naxalite question
scenes.summary: Second true-story question asks about Naxalite surrender discoveries; host reads absurd multiple-choice options.

scenes.title: Naxalites True Story Round
scenes.summary: True Story round zeroes in on Naxalite surrenderers; Kaniz lands on Japan, Rohan nails the vasectomy fact, and the panel debates where they should relocate.

scenes.title: Taliban Penal Code
scenes.summary: Abish clarifies the Taliban penal code wording with a multi-wives permutation joke; Rohan offers a creative Arundhati Roy guess; Abish lands the camel answer.

scenes.title: South Stars Monikers
scenes.summary: Host asks fans for Prabhas's moniker; audience says Shri, panel guesses wrong titles, and Rohan correctly identifies Rebel Star before the host confuses it with Bahubali.

scenes.title: Round 1: Buzz Round
scenes.summary: Host runs the star-title buzz round; guessers buzz in on Stylish Star, shooting star, and five star titles; round ends with a scorecard tally.

scenes.title: Audience Round
scenes.summary: Audience member Jeet guesses murder in the Haldiram proprietor case, then chooses a box that knocks Abish out of the lead; points are reconciled and scores are updated.

scenes.title: Round 2: Pick Me Behaviour
scenes.summary: Host reveals nine category cards for Pick Me Behaviour; lead contestant Rohan picks a category and is rosted by the host with a 20-point deduction.

scenes.title: True Story: Morarji Desai Leak
scenes.summary: Host asks about Morarji Desai's accidental leak of Indian intelligence to Pakistani General Zia-ul-Haq; panel debates batting order, Coke Studio, Rekha-Amitabh, and Dhurandhar before the correct nuclear answer emerges.

scenes.title: The Right Answer and Aftermath
scenes.summary: Host confirms the right answer; panel roasts the wrong guesses, discusses cricket-diplomacy confusion, and trades Hindi wordplay.

scenes.title: Cricket, Coke Studio, and the Improv Tease
scenes.summary: Guest jokes over Sachin in the 1970s, Sanju Samson, and Samsung; Rohan Joshi then nominates the improv segment's title.

scenes.title: Improv: Ye Toh Tatti Hai
scenes.summary: Host demeans improv; Biswa notes worse jokes were removed out of courtesy; Kaneez notes pressing buttons; host defines improv's limits before the disclaimer.

scenes.title: Pre-Round Banter & Scorekeeping
scenes.summary: Guests and host trade improvised lines about the show's lowered standards, stand-up labels, and low-budget hiring; host tallies Kaniz's early score.

scenes.title: Barbeque Nation Round
scenes.summary: Kaniz Surka selects Barbeque Nation and the host frames a joke about Iran becoming a barbequed nation after a 2026 attack.

scenes.title: True Story: Israel-Iran Conflict
scenes.summary: Host asks which of four options did not result from a 2026 Israel-America strike on Iran; Kaniz guesses none of the above, Abish picks A, and the gag around USS Khalifa and Epstein derives.

scenes.title: Deduction & Misdirection
scenes.summary: Host reveals both Kaniz and Abish were wrong; Rohan drolls through a Sherlock deduction and names an episode his favorite before a tone shift.

scenes.title: Jeffrey Epstein Final Question
scenes.summary: Host reads a bizarre Epstein-Ambani exchange and issues an open-ended question about the reply time; the window closes on the setup.

scenes.title: True Story climax & Scoreboard
scenes.summary: Host poses final True Story question and Abish answers correctly as the round ends.

scenes.title: Transition to Who Am I
scenes.summary: Host announces scores, reveals leaderboard, and sets up blindfold round for fans watching on YouTube.

scenes.title: Rohan faces Stephen Hawking
scenes.summary: Host gives clues leading to Stephen Hawking and Rohan guesses before the blindfold reveal.

scenes.title: Rohan's correct guess
scenes.summary: Rohan buzzes correct answer with an expletive celebration and the host reacts.

scenes.title: Kaneez's turn begins
scenes.summary: Host wraps Rohan and teases Kaneez's next person before shifting to her turn.

scenes.title: First clues and wrong buzz
scenes.summary: Host delivers 'mummy' and 'hak se single' hints; Kaneez guesses Zakir Khan wrong.

scenes.title: Escalating hints
scenes.summary: More clues given; Hindi-English banter on singlehood continues as rounds build tension.

scenes.title: Final clue and panic
scenes.summary: Host reveals final 'aakhri pasta' clue and Kaneez asks for repeats in final moments.

scenes.title: Modi ji & safe word
scenes.summary: Kaneez exclaims 'Modi ji!' and Rohan bets money; host later reveals she is wrong.

scenes.title: Answer reveal & roast
scenes.summary: Host confirms Rahul Gandhi; Rohan delivers a final roast and the round closes.

scenes.title: Final Guess: Clues Read
scenes.summary: Host introduces final guesser and reads the first two clues of the guessing round.

scenes.title: Final Guess: Clues & Banter
scenes.summary: Host reads clues three and four; Abish guesses Elon Musk wrong; host reads final clue.

scenes.title: Reveal & Blindfold Gag
scenes.summary: Host reveals Adolf Hitler; guests help remove Abish's blindfold; host maintains gag.

scenes.title: Zero Scores
scenes.summary: Host announces Abish and Kaneez both have zero points after wrong guesses.

scenes.title: Winner Wager & Rewards
scenes.summary: Rohan wagers 250 points and is declared winner with 990 points; receives vintage AIB merch.

scenes.title: Episode End & Sponsor
scenes.summary: Host wraps up the episode and plugs dementia.com innerwear for men.

scenes.title: Season Two & 2.5 BHK
